visual_review.conclusion: Original field positions, navigation and panel structure remain. Existing small help text explains applicability and wraps within both columns; disabled fields remain visible. Parking errors focus the active dwell input and are visible on mobile. No horizontal page overflow.
visual_review.accessibility: All three applicability hints are connected through aria-describedby; irrelevant fields are disabled and not required.
visual_review.baseline_fixes: Empty dwell no longer blocks actual objects/access inference; unused direction cannot cause a user edit/reconfirmation loop. Parking re-enables and validates the retained blank draft; direction choice survives rule changes.
